Class RenderPassDesc

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.engine.RenderPassDesc
public final class RenderPassDesc extends Object
Information about a render pass. This structure is designed to be mutable.

    • mColorAttachments

      @Size(max=8L) public @NonNull RenderPassDesc.AttachmentDesc @NonNull [] mColorAttachments
      If RenderPassDesc.AttachmentDesc.isUsed() return false, it means it's a mock/placeholder attachment. This array can be empty.

    • mColorResolveAttachment

      public final @NonNull RenderPassDesc.AttachmentDesc mColorResolveAttachment
      If RenderPassDesc.AttachmentDesc.isUsed() return true, it means there's color resolve attachment, and MSAA will be auto resolved, and resolve image format must match MSAA image format, and resolve StoreOp should be Store.

      If MSAA LoadOp is Load/Clear, then resolve LoadOp should be Discard.

    • mDepthStencilAttachment

      public final @NonNull RenderPassDesc.AttachmentDesc mDepthStencilAttachment
      If RenderPassDesc.AttachmentDesc.isUsed() return true, it means there's depth stencil attachment.
